title: Confinement
text: “He enjoys strong public support, and everyone believes that Mr. Iwatani is the one truly fit to be our country’s king. Please be kind to Melty.”

This… essentially means that the queen has bestowed the throne upon Father. Come to think of it, given the current situation, I doubt that the queen’s mere return would be enough to convince the Revolutionary Army. Just as the authority of that disgraced Trash has crumbled, the Queen’s power has likely weakened accordingly due to this upheaval. That’s why she needs her Father—whom the people desire—and a Finacée who can win over the Revolutionary Army.
Hmm, Father as king? That’s a truly brilliant plan. For a figure of his stature, it wouldn’t be at all surprising if he were treated as the pinnacle of the people… a king… no, a god.

How could I have failed to realize this? Although he started out as the lord of a humble fiefdom in the first world, I’m beginning to think that becoming a monarch is the best path for Father. Once we’ve destroyed the Takt forces, we’ll absorb Faubrey as well, and Father will reign as the King of the World. Well, that is, if Father so desires.
“I, too, will act as a representative of the nation, but I implore you… for the sake of our country, please save more people than ever before and quell the turmoil.”
“Gnnnnnnn—No way! No wayyyyyy!”
The Trash, enraged, breaks free from the soldiers’ grip and tries to lunge at Father. What a futile effort…
“I won’t let you. Icicle Prison!”
Thanks to the Queen’s Magic, Trash was trapped in an icy cage.
“Aultcray, understand this well. Your era is over.”
“I won’t stand for it! You say the Shield Hero is to become king of this country!? That goes against the Melromarc family creed, which has been passed down through generations! I cannot accept it!”

“There’s nothing to ‘accept’ here. The people believe that the Shield Hero is the one truly fit to lead this nation. Aultcray, you are the Staff Hero. I won’t take your life. Now, lock this old-fashioned, outdated king… away in the castle tower.”
“What did you say!?”
“Just think of it as only being able to go outside during the tides.”
This is what they call house arrest, isn’t it? They won’t kill him, but he’ll never be able to live freely again. The only emotion welling up inside me is “Serves you right!”
“Guh! My wife! You must not, must not make the Shield Hero king!”
And just like that, that Trash was dragged away from the throne room. I can still hear his screams faintly, but they’re gradually fading into the distance.
“…May there be meaning in the fact that the Staff Hero has not yet abandoned you.”
The Queen watched him go as if in prayer, then raised her head. The representatives from Siltvelt watched the scene unfold with mixed emotions.
“Lord Kawasumi, the decision has already been made. I ask for your understanding.”
“Ugh… I understand. So, what punishment do you intend to impose on me this time?”
In response to Itsuki’s question, the Queen opened her fan to hide her mouth as she replied.

“Nothing in particular… but Lord Kawasumi’s reputation in our country is poor, and it is predicted that it will be difficult for you to carry out your activities here. If possible, it would be in your best interest to conduct your activities in another country for a while.”
“That’s a roundabout way of saying I’m being exiled!”
This is ridiculous—to insist on justice only to end up exiled because of his own actions. I can’t stop laughing. It’s truly a case of what goes around comes around.
“Because he was doing bad things without realizing it, he wasn’t appreciated—and now he’s being exiled like this!”

There couldn’t be a more fitting response to what Itsuki said after receiving the reward money. I wonder how it feels to have your own words come back at you? …Oh my, I feel like I understand that feeling. It seems like a fair share of them bounced right back at me, especially in the first world.
“You’ve been so noisy this whole time! Do you really get that much pleasure from seeing someone suffer?!”
“Look, Father! Itsuki is really angry. He just doesn’t have enough self-control!”
“Motoyasu, don’t provoke him!”
I was laughing heartily at the enraged Itsuki when my father scolded me. It seems that every time he tries to stand up from the throne, the Queen begs him to stay seated, so he can’t seem to get up.
“Giving Itsuki time to think and a roundabout banishment—that sounds like a contradiction to me.”

“That’s why it’s only for a short while. This is something I was planning to report later during the banquet, but active phenomena have been observed on the island of Cal Mira, located in the waters near this country.”

Itsuki and Ren stared intently at the Queen. After all, they’re the kind of folks who love leveling up, no matter what. If they can level up easily, any slight discomfort will probably blow right away.

What can I say? Back in the day, even when I was upset that Crimson Swine—who I’d believed was a comrade at the time—had suffered a terrible fate, I eventually forgot all about it. Well, you could also say I didn’t think much of Crimson Swine to begin with.
“We believe that if the Heroes could participate until the fervor surrounding this recent incident dies down, it would help calm the people’s excitement and quell the bad rumors about the Bow Hero.”
“Will that really work…?”
“After the event on Cal Mira Island, if you carry out activities in other countries for a while, it will be possible to improve Lord Kawasumi’s reputation during that time.”
“H-how?”
“The Four Saints are beings equal to gods. The people would be skeptical if such a god were to commit evil deeds. Don’t you understand, Lord Iwatani? The story of the fake Hero.”
“Ah… I see. So, instead of the real Bow Hero, we’ll claim that an imposter posing as a Hero wreaked havoc on Melromarc.”

“Yes. “Therefore, if Lord Kawasumi were to operate in another country for a while, it would become possible for him to operate in Melromarc as well. However, please understand that reckless actions like those in the past will no longer be possible.”

“If you’d like, there’s no problem with sending an official letter to a country that welcomes the Four Saints. Faubrey, the country of origin for the Four Saint Heroes, is likely ready to accept him as well.”
At the queen’s words, Father turns his gaze toward me. This is dangerous. If Itsuki goes to Faubrey, he’ll undoubtedly fall prey to Takt and get stuck in a loop.
“Your Majesty, just a moment.”
“What is it?”
Father is speaking to the Queen in a whisper. He’s asking her to do everything possible to keep Itsuki from going to Faubrey.
“……Understood.”
The Queen gave a slight nod and turned toward Itsuki.
“However, since there are already heroes active in his country who share the same faith, I cannot guarantee that there will be a place for Lord Kawasumi.”

Oh… That’s a response that clearly understands Itsuki’s personality—how much he cares about others’ opinions. No hero would willingly venture into a place where a hero with a similar profile is already active. It would essentially lead to a turf war. With that, there’s no longer any need to worry about Itsuki being killed by Takt.
“I don’t think Lord Kawasumi would want any unnecessary conflict either. What do you say?”
“Ugh…”
He’s at a loss for words. Apparently, Itsuki’s knowledge of games is rather one-sided. He’s probably reluctant to go to an unfamiliar country.
“O-okay. I’ll go to judge a country where there are no heroes and evil has taken root.”
“The Four Saints are asked to participate in each nation for the sake of the world. Please forgive us if the mission ahead proves far more difficult than any you’ve faced before.”
“Got it. As long as this puts an end to all this trouble, we’ve got no complaints.”
Ren nodded at that. Frankly, what exactly did you do? You level-up addict!
“Then, I would like to offer my deepest apologies for dragging you Heroes into this commotion.”
With that, the Queen bowed deeply. She then declared the meeting adjourned. With the exception of my Father, the heroes were about to leave the throne room, but…
“M-Motoyasu-kun.”
“What is it?”
“For now, Motoyasu-kun and everyone else, please stay behind. I’d like to talk with you here.”
“Understood. Alright, everyone, wait here just as Father said.”
“Understood.”
“Got it.”

Yuki-chan and Kou replied, while Keel, Luna-chan, my Finacée, and Sakura-chan nodded. The Lazy Pig was leaning against the corner of the room, raising his hand as if it were a bother. My Assistant and Rival glared at Ren’s retreating back with displeasure before quietly nodding. Given the solemn occasion, the panda beastman and his subordinates seemed tense, completely absorbed by the atmosphere around them.
